entities.name: Lucas
entities.description: A hybrid from DEW from an experiment who has a big army of fast runner clones and shared his blood to make them.
entities.quote: when zayn and weston was fighting against lucas . who was a hybrid from dew from experiment...the fight was to intense for even these two.. and then we see a lucas has a big army .all of them were fast runner like weston.like lucas.as lucas shared his blood to these for making his own army

timeline_events.title: Catastrophe Moment Against the Superstrong Enemy
timeline_events.description: Weston and Zayn fight a superstrong and very fast enemy who attempts to destroy the city with a bomb, but an injured Weston intercepts the blast with his own body while Zayn launches a final aerial attack.
timeline_events.quote: and in s5,we see this moment again.fighting another big enemy.this is catestrophy moment.where we again see both weston and zayn fighting this enemy.that enemy is superstrong and also very fast. but this time at the very end time while the enemy uses his ability to literally destroy the whole city level bomb.
